# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description — VulnSpeed

```html
<h2>VulnSpeed — GPU-Accelerated SAST for Real-Time Vulnerability Detection</h2>

<p>
  Security scanning at the speed of thought. VulnSpeed detects OWASP Top 10 and CWE Top 25
  vulnerabilities as you type across 7 languages, with one-click auto-fixes and optional
  GPU acceleration for instant results on large codebases.
</p>

<h3>Real-Time Detection</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>As-You-Type Scanning</b> — Vulnerabilities highlighted inline in the editor with severity levels</li>
  <li><b>OWASP Top 10 Coverage</b> — Injection, broken access control, cryptographic failures, SSRF, and more</li>
  <li><b>CWE Top 25 Coverage</b> — SQL injection, XSS, OS command injection, and 22+ more (Pro)</li>
  <li><b>7 Languages</b> — Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C/C++, and Swift</li>
</ul>

<h3>Remediation</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>One-Click Auto-Fix</b> — Alt+Enter to apply automated remediation suggestions instantly</li>
  <li><b>File Scanning</b> — Right-click in editor to scan the current file on demand</li>
  <li><b>Project Scanning</b> — Right-click a folder to scan the entire project with severity breakdown</li>
  <li><b>Security Dashboard</b> — Tool window with vulnerability list, statistics, and quick access to fixes</li>
</ul>

<h3>Advanced Analysis (Pro)</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>GPU Acceleration</b> — Metal/CUDA/Vulkan accelerated engine, 50-100x faster than CPU scanning</li>
  <li><b>Taint Analysis</b> — Advanced data flow tracking across function boundaries</li>
  <li><b>AI False Positive Filtering</b> — ML-based filtering to reduce noise</li>
  <li><b>Custom Security Rules</b> — Define organization-specific vulnerability patterns</li>
  <li><b>Compliance Reports</b> — Generate SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS reports</li>
  <li><b>CI/CD Integration</b> — Run VulnSpeed in your pipeline for gated security checks</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free:</b> Real-time OWASP Top 10 detection, inline warnings, basic auto-fix, file/project scanning</li>
  <li><b>Pro:</b> Full CWE Top 25, GPU acceleration, taint analysis, custom rules, compliance reports, CI/CD integration</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2023.3+ (or any JetBrains IDE)</li>
  <li>JDK 11+</li>
  <li>2 GB free RAM</li>
  <li>GPU optional (Metal, CUDA, or Vulkan for Pro acceleration)</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li><a href="https://github.com/JirakJ/vulnspeed-plugin/issues">Issue Tracker</a></li>
  <li><a href="https://github.com/JirakJ/vulnspeed-plugin">Documentation</a></li>
</ul>
```
